entries.en: No no, don't hang up...! No...! I'm entirely within my rights... Oh... Oh, and what would you know...? I am her mother, god dammit!
entries.ro: Nu, nu, nu închide...! Nu...! Am tot dreptul... Oh... Oh, și tu ce-ai ști...? Sunt mama ei, mama dracului!

entries.en: Do I have time...? Of course I would... Of course... For her? Why, anything at all!
entries.ro: Am timp...? Sigur că aș avea... Sigur... Pentru ea? Păi, orice!

entries.en: I'll ring you after the meeting.
Now look here! This just isn't on!
entries.ro: Stai puțin! Așa ceva nu se face!

entries.en: I just don't have time for this nonsense!
Stay back! Or shall I call the NCPD!
entries.ro: Stai în spate! Sau să chem NCPD-ul?
